title: GUIDE-CAC: Statin-Ezetimibe Without Aspirin vs. Statin Monotherapy With Aspirin in High Coronary Calcification

sections.abstract: A Multicenter, randomized trial comparing the efficacy and safety of intensive lipid-lowering therapy using a statin-ezetimibe combination without aspirin versus statin monotherapy with aspirin in asymptomatic patients with coronary artery calcification
